svg.aria-label: design-flow: Screens in Figma, their flow beside them. A developer can build each page from one look. Steps: Inventory, the file's tokens, styles, components; Capture, live page to auto-layout layers; Tokenize, every value bound to a variable; States, each result screen captured; Flow, drawn from the app source; Review, no crossings, every line lands. Output: a screen and its flow per page, an implementation checklist.
